title: K122471: SOMATOM Definition (P45), 510(k) summary and clearance letter
version: 510(k) K122471, September 2012 regulatory file for a SOMATOM Definition software version.
lineage: FDA archive preserves the manufacturer’s technical description and earlier clearance reference for the same P45 platform.

passages.note: Names the P45 as SOMATOM Definition and describes reconstruction of cross-sections from X-ray transmission data taken at a number of angles.
